name: Macswarm
tagline: macOS VMs on Apple silicon for Claude Code and Codex, with Xcode and Simulators.
description: Macswarm runs macOS virtual machines ("Pods") on Apple silicon and exposes them to coding agents. Claude Code attaches through Anthropic's self-hosted environments; Codex through the OpenAI Agents API webhook. A Pod ships with the Latest Xcode, iOS runtimes, pre-booted Simulators, XcodeBuildMCP and a two-slot build queue, so an agent can run xcodebuild, boot a Simulator and read test results on a machine it does not have locally. Two to three agents share a Pod. Billing is per Pod-hour, metered per second; idle Pods stop. Each Pod is cloned from a golden image and destroyed after the session, with outbound-only networking. Regions: EU (Netherlands) and US. Free plan: 3 Pod-hours, no card.
